title: Can the impossibility theorem be fully formalized in Lean using Mathlib's Mea...
description: Can the impossibility theorem be fully formalized in Lean using Mathlib's MeasureTheory infrastructure? The argument is elementary but requires formalizing infinite disjoint families of sets with the same measure.

insights: Core argument: N*c ≤ μ(B(0,4/3)) < ∞ for all N → c = 0 (Archimedean property)
ENNReal Archimedean: case split on c=⊤, then lift to NNReal or use ENNReal.exists_nat_gt
Translation invariance: μ.map (fun x => x + v) = μ ↔ μ(ball x r) = μ(ball 0 r)
Preimage of ball(0,r) under (· + -x) equals ball(x,r): dist(y + -x, 0) = ‖y-x‖ = dist(y,x)
measure_biUnion_finset gives N*c = μ(∪_{n<N} f n) for disjoint equal-measure sets
ENNReal API fixes: pos_of_ne_zero → pos_iff_ne_zero.mpr; div_mul_cancel₀ → div_mul_cancel; mul_lt_mul_right' argument order fixed
